content:
The linear projection(s) onto a subspace S of a vector space E have two avatars : one valued in S, and one valued in E. Both versions are interesting: the first one is obviously more precise, and the second one gives an idempotent element of the algebra of endomorphisms.

Right now our naming is a mess. We have docs#Submodule.linearProjOfIsCompl vs docs#Submodule.IsCompl.projection in algebraic land, and docs#Submodule.orthogonalProjection vs docs#Submodule.starProjection in Hilbertian land. Since I am about to add a third pair in #38547, I think we should sort this out.

My proposal is the following : we call projection the endomorphism version and projectionOnto the subtype valued version. In practice:

  • docs#Submodule.linearProjOfIsCompl would become Submodule.IsCompl.projectionOnto
  • docs#Submodule.IsCompl.projection keeps its name
  • docs#Submodule.orthogonalProjection becomes Submodule.orthogonalProjectionOnto
  • docs#Submodule.starProjection becomes Submodule.orthogonalProjection

Does this seem reasonable ?

Following discussion at #mathlib4 > Pretty printing props and ⋯, here's another proposal for names:

  • docs#Submodule.linearProjOfIsCompl would become Submodule.projectionOnto
  • docs#Submodule.IsCompl.projection becomes Submodule.projection
  • the topological version of docs#Submodule.linearProjOfIsCompl would be called Submodule.projectionOntoL
  • the topological version of docs#Submodule.IsCompl.projection would be called Submodule.projectionL
  • docs#Submodule.orthogonalProjection becomes Submodule.orthogonalProjectionOnto
  • docs#Submodule.starProjection becomes Submodule.orthogonalProjection
@Yaël Dillies What do you think about thse names?
I'm happy with these names. Thanks for the unification!
Yes, this set of names looks great!
